<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Current ITIN Processing Times</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">As of 2026, the IRS processes ITIN applications in 6-11 weeks from the date of receipt. However, several factors can affect this timeline.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">Factors That Affect Processing Time</h2>

<h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground mt-8 mb-3">Peak Season Delays</h3>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">During tax season (January-April), processing times can extend to 12-14 weeks due to high volume.</p>

<h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground mt-8 mb-3">Application Errors</h3>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">Applications with missing documents or incorrect Form W-7 information are returned, causing significant delays.</p>

<h3 class="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground mt-8 mb-3">Mailing Time</h3>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">International mail to and from the IRS can add 2-4 weeks to the total timeline.</p>

<h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mt-12 mb-4">How to Speed Up Your ITIN Application</h2>

<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">1. Submit an error-free Form W-7</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">2. Include all required documents</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">3. Use an IRS-authorized CAA to avoid mailing originals</p>
<p class="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">4. Apply outside of peak tax season</p>
